# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature in the repository's **Security** tab.

Do not open a public issue containing credentials, playlist addresses, private stream URLs, provider details, tokens, personal information, or unredacted logs. Include only the minimum sanitized information needed to reproduce the issue.

The project is under active development. Supported release versions will be listed here before Tvium is distributed publicly.
